_help: Settings for the weekly publication update. See README.md.
_extra_dois_help: DOIs to add by hand when OpenAlex has not linked them to Dr. Evanseck yet (e.g. new meeting abstracts). Example: ["10.1016/j.bpj.2025.11.1234"]
_abstract_journal_issns_help: Journals searched first in Crossref for meeting abstracts (0006-3495 = Biophysical Journal, where BPS abstracts are published).
_text_fixes_help: Corrections for garbled characters in OpenAlex data. Left side: text as it arrives (� is the broken-character symbol). Right side: what to show.

dissertations._help: Weekly check of Duquesne's dissertation archive for dissertations chaired by Dr. Evanseck.

covers._help: Weekly check for journal covers featuring the group's papers. Add a paper's DOI to 'hide' to remove a cover that was picked up by mistake.
